messages.author: 5fa2a363d4ddd1d1
messages.subject: Nimble Version 0.4-1 released
parts:
Dear nimble-users and nimble-announce,

We're pleased to announce that we've released version 0.4-1 of NIMBLE at
R-nimble.org.

Version 0.4-1 is a minor release. Highlights include
- addition of an elliptical slice sampler to the MCMC engine, part of
our effort to
expand and enhance the built-in algorithms provided with NIMBLE,
- fix of a bug preventing use of nimbleFunctions in packages
depending on NIMBLE, and
- reduction in the C++ compiler warnings on Windows during use of
compileNimble.

More details on the NIMBLE web page and the NEWS file of the package.

As always, we're interested to know what you are interested in using
NIMBLE for and what would make it better. You can email the
development team directly at nimble...@gmail.com or share with the
nimble-users list at nimble...@googlegroups.com.

- Chris Paciorek for the NIMBLE Development Team
